definition: The area under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve, summarizing a classifier's ability to distinguish between classes across thresholds.
details: An AUC of 1.0 indicates perfect separability, while 0.5 indicates performance no better than random guessing.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. And that, done honestly, is ROC-AUC.
